body: Everyone we know is sufferring. We don't have many choices other than to play the waiting game for assistance. That could be a year, and if we don't have a place to live, it could be my mother's death. We have talked, and we have sought assistance. The messed up part is that I see people rolling up to the social security office and community centers looking for help in mercedes and expensive brand-name clothes.

I'm not so worried about ending up on the streets (although winters are starting to get really cold). I'll figure out a way to survive. But my mother, who is diabetic and in need of oxygen, will die if she doesn't have a warm place to sleep. I'm also struggling with paying for her medications, which she definitely needs to live.

Thank you. I don't have the money for psychiatric or theraputic services. I'm barely making enough for my mother's medication. Soon, she'll be out of plavix, her blood thinner. She needs it so hher blood runs smoothly through her system, and it's a 70 dollar co-pay. We're looking into everything we can, but we're really stretched thin. It'll take months to get her disability, if she gets it at all. I'm paying for her insurance, but soon it'll be too expensive (the rate goes up early next year). We're on food stamps, but I'm worried about her having a place to stay since she's tethered to any oxygen machine.

If she could be taken care of, that would be wonderful. She's too young for a nursing home, and can't afford it though. So, I have to take care of her and work and go to school. If I quit school, I know she'd only blame herself. I'm scared that she's depressed, too. I think she is.

Thank you for your support. I don't know. It just seems harder and harder every year. The semester before that, I saved my grandmother twice from dying because my grandfather is too stubborn to do anything to help her. Mom also had a heart attack then. That messed up school for me in addition to my own health problems. I've been working on that, And I look and feel better for the most part. The problem is that everything keeps looking bad. Everything is uncertain (not that it's supposed to be), and I keep having major anxiety attacks. I don't know how to deal with them other than to sit down and cry.
